title: Add White Plaid Lace and Dark Stussy Grunge wallpapers to collection

requirements.text: Add two new wallpaper options — 'White Plaid Lace' and 'Dark Stussy Grunge' — to the usePersonalization hook's texture options map, pointing to their respective generated image assets in frontend/public/assets/generated.

quotes: Add them where the other wallpapers are

acceptanceCriteria: usePersonalization hook includes 'whitePlaidLace' and 'darkStussyGrunge' as valid texture keys
Each key maps to the correct asset path under frontend/public/assets/generated

requirements.text: Add 'White Plaid Lace' and 'Dark Stussy Grunge' as selectable thumbnail options in the PersonalizationPanel component alongside the existing wallpaper thumbnails, maintaining the existing 4-column grid layout.

quotes: Add them where the other wallpapers are

acceptanceCriteria: PersonalizationPanel displays thumbnails for both new wallpapers
Selecting either new wallpaper applies it as the app background
Layout remains a 4-column grid consistent with existing options

requirements.text: Add 'White Plaid Lace' and 'Dark Stussy Grunge' as selectable options in the Personalization page (frontend/src/pages/Personalization.tsx), displaying their thumbnails in the existing grid alongside current options.

quotes: Add them where the other wallpapers are

acceptanceCriteria: Personalization page shows both new wallpaper thumbnails
Selecting them updates the persisted background preference

requirements.text: Render the generated wallpaper images (white-plaid-lace.dim_1280x720.jpg and dark-stussy-grunge.dim_1280x720.jpg) as static assets placed in frontend/public/assets/generated so they can be referenced by the personalization hook and components.
acceptanceCriteria: Both image files exist under frontend/public/assets/generated
Images load correctly when applied as background in the app

constraints: Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any files under frontend/src/components/ui
New wallpaper asset filenames must match exactly what is referenced in usePersonalization hook
nonGoals: Adding any new app features beyond the two wallpapers
Changing existing wallpaper entries or restructuring the wallpaper grid layout

required: Light gray diagonal plaid pattern with black lace trim along the bottom edge, clean and delicate textile aesthetic (white-plaid-lace.dim_1280x720.jpg)

High-contrast black background with large off-white Stussy graffiti-style logo text on the left and a close-up of bared teeth on the right, grungy streetwear aesthetic (dark-stussy-grunge.dim_1280x720.jpg)
